components.name: Toolbar icon button
components.description: Compact icon action with a tooltip and press feedback.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-icon" title="Refresh readings" aria-label="Refresh readings"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M17.65 6.35A7.95 7.95 0 0 0 12 4a8 8 0 1 0 7.93 9h-2.02A6 6 0 1 1 12 6c1.66 0 3.14.69 4.22 1.78L13 11h7V4l-2.35 2.35Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon { background: transparent; color: #5f586b; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; transition: scale 120ms cubic-bezier(.23, 1, .32, 1); } .ds-icon:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #544387 8%, transparent); } .ds-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #544387; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-icon:active { scale: .96; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-icon { transition: none; } .ds-icon:active { scale: 1; } }

components.name: Back button
components.description: Returns to the reading index from the reader or settings.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-back"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M20 11H7.83l5.59-5.59L12 4l-8 8 8 8 1.42-1.41L7.83 13H20v-2Z"/></svg> All readings</button>
components.css: .ds-back { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; color: #544387; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-back:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #544387 8%, transparent); } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #544387; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Tonal retry button
components.description: Starts another attempt from a recoverable reading status.
components.css: .ds-retry { color: #484458; background: #e6dff9; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-retry:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #484458 8%, #e6dff9); } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #544387; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Appearance selector
components.description: Shows one selected appearance within a single outlined control.
components.css: .ds-segments { display: flex; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #79757f; border-radius: 999px; width: min(100%, 376px); overflow: hidden; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #23212a; } .ds-segments label { position: relative; min-width: 0; flex: 1; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segments label + label { border-left: 1px solid #79757f; } .ds-segments input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-segments span { display: block; padding: 9px 6px; } .ds-segments input:checked + span { background: #e6dff9; color: #484458; } .ds-segments label:hover span { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 999px rgb(84 67 135 / 8%); } .ds-segments input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid #544387; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Settings dropdown
components.description: A full-width outlined field with a visible setting label.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: block; width: min(100%, 376px); color: #5f586b; font: 12px/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: -9px; left: 11px; padding: 0 4px; background: #fdfcfe; } .ds-field select { width: 100%; background: #f7f5f9; color: #23212a; padding: 16px 12px; border: 1px solid #79757f; border-radius: 10px; font: 16px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field select:hover { border-color: #23212a; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #544387; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Celebration card
components.description: Shows the celebration and its labelled LitCal colours. This example uses red.
components.html:
Saint Andrew Dũng-Lạc, Priest, and Companions, Martyrs

Ordinary Time · Memorial

Red
components.css: .ds-celebration { max-width: 376px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(68 22 29 / 20%); border-radius: 14px; background: #f3e5e7; color: #23212a; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-celebration h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.27; letter-spacing: -.4px; } .ds-celebration p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #5f586b; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-celebration .ds-swatch { display: flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center; margin-top: 8px; color: #44161d; font-weight: 600; } .ds-swatch i { width: 10px; height: 10px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #79757f; border-radius: 50%; background: #8b0000; }

components.name: Reading row
components.description: Opens the cited passage from the daily index.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: min(100%, 376px); text-align: start; padding: 7px 4px; color: #23212a; background: transparent; border: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: #5f586b; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-row svg { color: #544387; flex: none; } .ds-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #544387 8%, transparent); } .ds-row:focus-visible { background: rgb(84 67 135 / 16%); outline: 2px solid #544387; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Reading status panel
components.description: Explains missing content and shows recovery when available.
components.html:
Passage text unavailable

Bible API couldn’t provide this citation in the selected translation.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 11px; max-width: 376px; padding: 14px; background: #f7f5f9; color: #23212a; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status svg { flex: none; margin-top: 2px; color: #544387; } .ds-status strong { font: 600 14px/1.35 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status p { margin: 3px 0 9px; color: #5f586b; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-retry { color: #484458; background: #e6dff9; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-retry:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #484458 8%, #e6dff9); } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #544387; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: Neutral chrome keeps daily lookup quick and gives the reading space to breathe. The date navigator and celebration are the strongest visual cues in the index. In the reader, the passage label and citation carry that hierarchy into a simple text column.
keyCharacteristics: Inter headings and comfortably spaced scripture.
A liturgical accent that follows the selected celebration.
dos: Do use the same content gutter for the index, reader, settings, and source footer.
Do keep citations visible when passage text is unavailable.
Do use the same liturgical accent across the celebration, date navigator, and reader.
